title: CFDE Liver SCB Documentation
bodyHtml: Integrated human liver tissue reference map developed using single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) from the Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE) programs HuBMAP and SenNet and additional external sources. Within a selected dataset, visualize interactive plots of cell type clusters, gene expression, cell type abundance, and marker gene expression. Query a gene name and filter results using the desired parameters. Please be patient, as data may take time to load. To explore computationally derived gene programs from this map and associated cell states, see here. To learn more about canonical cell types in the healthy human liver, see here.
